description: Fixed, reviewable data policy for the Claude-to-Codex relay transport. The relay moves one validated report and one structured verdict between two local mailbox slots. It never invokes Codex, never runs a model, never touches repository files, and never mutates the Session Registry. A verdict is an opinion: PASS means only that a second reader found no objection, and it grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution. Every contract value below is fixed; a policy that disagrees is refused, so no field here can weaken a limit, add an operation, enable a retry, or downgrade an escalation. Pure data: no regular expression, no executable construct, no command, no environment value, no machine path, no credential, and no disable switch.

planned_reviewer.note: Recorded as data for the future one-shot runner, which is NOT part of this transport and is not yet authorized. The relay never reads these to build a command line; it starts no external process.

non_authorization_sentence: This verdict grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution.
